description: Verify that the runbook explicitly defines a 'read-only' scope for the browser task, ensuring no write, delete, or modify actions are permitted.
Confirm that the runbook specifies a per-host grant mechanism, limiting access to specific hostnames rather than global or wildcard domains.
Ensure that an explicit expiry or expiration date/time is defined for the access grant.
Validate that the runbook includes a section or step detailing how to revoke or handle the grant upon expiry.
